Config.Title: Summary Configuration
Config.DialogText: Do you want to delete this filter?
Config.FilterRegExpHint: Must be valid Regular Expression with one capture group
Config.FilterCallbackHint: Must be valid JavaScript that evaluates to boolean value
Config.AdditionalHint: Comma separated property paths of Item that lead to a single value or an Array of values. To add a label, append the path with pipe symbol and some text (i.e. 'item.damage|Damage')
Config.FilterAttributesHint: Every line is an attribute to display. It needs to be a valid path on actor. You can add label by appending the path with pipe and some text (i.e. 'system.currentCareer.name|Career')

Errors.Callback: There was an error evaluating a Filter Callback. Check console (F12) for details.

Errors.Attribute: Value of 'Actor.{path}' is neither an Array, String or Number.
